label: Bible Study
prompt: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no _____, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
verse: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
note: Too many sheep, not enough pasture — Abram settles it by letting his nephew Lot choose first.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of _____: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
verse: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
note: 'Prisoners of hope' — Zechariah's lovely name for people held fast by God's promises, with double to come.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that _____, and the tables of the covenant;
verse: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
note: Inside the ark of the covenant: the tables, a pot of manna, and Aaron's rod that budded (Numbers 17:8).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Little children, keep yourselves from _____. Amen.
verse: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
note: John's first letter ends abruptly on this line — anything that takes God's place is an idol.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, _____ thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verse: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
note: Enlarge the tent, 'lengthen thy cords' — the text of William Carey's 1792 'Expect great things' missions sermon.
